newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers skid on slipping cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers skid on slipping cargo prices.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes fell from Thursday's levels with more traders projecting softer cargo prices as Chinese import grinds to a halt, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst prices fell by at least $2 per tonne from Thursday to be indicated at $118/$120 and $124/$126.
"Some sellers are holding back offers, unwilling to sell at current low levels," said a trader
"Some bunker sellers are now dumping their supplies in the cargo market," said another trader.
MDO and gas oil prices were steady at $238-$242 and $248-$255 per tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
